title: fix(runtime): the declarative-endpoint fallback reads the body after the match and the policies
body:
Fixes #24252

Clause-②: no

Contract basis for the line above: only the order of refusals moves (the `404` and the `401` now answer ahead of the body's `400`). No request that was refused before is accepted, and no export moves.

## What was wrong

On the standalone server (`HonoServerPlugin` + the dispatcher plugin), the declarative-endpoint fallback (`setFallbackHandler` in `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`) built `runAppEndpointStep`'s request with `body: req.body`, before the step matched an endpoint or ran its policy chain. The transport's `req.body` is an accessor that throws its `400 INVALID_REQUEST` refusal for a body it could not parse, records the refusal, and answers the request with it whatever the handler then writes (`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`, `runHandler`). So:

- a `POST` to `/api/v1/apps/ns/...` that no declaration owns, with an unparseable JSON body, answered `400` where the same request with a readable body answers `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, signed in or not;
- an anonymous `POST` to an `authRequired: true` endpoint with an unparseable body answered `400` where `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` is owed. The card listed this case as inferred; it is now measured (below).

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: the fallback hands the step `deferRequestBody(req)` (the #24151 pair, `packages/runtime/src/deferred-request-body.ts`) instead of `req.body`.
- `packages/runtime/src/api-endpoint-step.ts`: the step reads it with `readDispatchedBody(request.body)` after `applyEndpointPolicies` has admitted the caller (rate limit, auth gate, `authRequired`), just before `inputMapping`. That is the step's one body read, and nothing above it touches the body. A body that was not deferred (a direct caller, a unit test) passes through unchanged, and with no mapping declared the request still rides on by reference.
- The "scoping test FIRST" property is unchanged: a path outside the `/apps/` carve-out still returns before any resolution, and a miss still writes nothing.
- New real-socket pins: `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.endpoint-fallback-body-after-match.integration.test.ts`.
- `.changeset/24252-endpoint-fallback-body-after-match.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/runtime`.

The deferred-body pair fits this seam without change: the step has exactly one body read, and it sits after the policy chain. The pair's guard also applies here: a future read of the deferred body before the resolve throws `UnresolvedRequestBodyRead` instead of quietly running the transport's refusal early.

## Measurements (dispatch assumptions A1 to A5)

Tree: `origin/main` `53ef75243` (BASE), fix at `d8dbf8b1d`, head `f23824394`.

- **A1, holds.** On BASE: `setFallbackHandler` at `:2151`, `runAppEndpointStep({` at `:2243`, `body: req.body` at `:2291`, built after `resolveRequestScope` and the multi-tenant decline and before any match.
- **A2, holds.** In code, the adapter's `get body()` throws `bodyReading.refusal` and sets `refusedBodyRead`; after the handler, a recorded refusal is the answer. On a socket, the before-readings below show it.
- **A3, holds.** Both functions exist. `runAppEndpointStep` reads the body once, at `applyInputMapping(match.endpoint, request.body)`, after the policy `deny` return. Neither the matcher nor `applyEndpointPolicies` receives the body.
- **A4, measured.** Anonymous caller, `authRequired: true` endpoint, unparseable body: `400 INVALID_REQUEST` before the fix, `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` after.
- **A5, no read before the match, in this repository.** `resolveRequestScope` runs `prepareResolverHints` (path and route params only), the host's `KernelResolver`, and `resolveExecutionContext` (no body reference). After the fix, the single-tenant socket pins answer `404` for an unmatched path, and that composition runs `resolveRequestScope` before the match. A throwaway probe (not committed) on the multi-tenant composition, with the existing multi-tenant test's stub resolver, read the same at the fixed head and with the fallback's `req.body` put back:

  | request (unparseable body) | fallback reads `req.body` | fixed |
  |---|---|---|
  | unplaced (no environment header), declared path | `404`, matcher asked 0 times | `404`, matcher asked 0 times |
  | unknown environment, declared path | `404` | `404` |
  | placed, unmatched path | `400 INVALID_REQUEST` | `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` |
  | placed, `authRequired: false` path (admitted) | `400 INVALID_REQUEST` | `400 INVALID_REQUEST` |

  The decline branch returns before the step's argument is built, so it never read the body. The real `KernelResolver` is host-supplied (the cloud distribution) and has no implementation in this repository: whether it reads `context.request.body` is NOT MEASURED here.

## Tests

New pins, on a real socket (LiteKernel + `HonoServerPlugin` on port 0 + the dispatcher plugin, with stubbed `auth`, `metadata.matchEndpoint` and `automation` slots). Refusal-shaped assertions check `status` and `error.code`. The transport refusal is told apart from a domain `INVALID_REQUEST` by its message, as #24151's pins do.

| case | BASE `53ef75243` | fix `d8dbf8b1d` |
|---|---|---|
| anonymous, unmatched path, unparseable body: `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` as for a readable body, matcher asked | red: `400` | green |
| signed-in, unmatched path, unparseable body: `404`, as above | red: `400` | green |
| anonymous, `authRequired: true`, unparseable body: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` as for a readable body, target never runs | red: `400` | green |
| control: signed-in, `authRequired: true`, unparseable body: transport `400` refusal, target never runs | green | green |
| control: anonymous, `authRequired: false`, unparseable body: transport `400` refusal, target never runs | green | green |
| control: signed-in, `authRequired: true`, readable body: `200`, flow receives `params: { days: 30 }` | green | green |

Existing suites, all green at the fix, in one run (11 files, 231 tests, `VERDICT command-exit 0`): the new file, `dispatcher-plugin.endpoint-fallback.integration.test.ts`, `api-endpoint-step.test.ts`, #24151's `dispatcher-body-after-anonymous-floor.hono.integration.test.ts` and `deferred-request-body.test.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.multi-tenant-endpoint.integration.test.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.endpoint-principal-less-deny.integration.test.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.streaming-fallback.test.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.fallback-absence-warn.test.ts`, `endpoint-flow-dispatch-status.test.ts`, `endpoint-flow-elevated-door.test.ts`.

Full package: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` at `50f9caa35` (same code as the head; later commits touch only the changeset): 417 files passed, 6553 passed and 19 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test file, with no `error TS` lines naming it. `check:test-typecheck` OK, ledger unchanged.

## Ablation (one time, both legs, on `d8dbf8b1d`)

Both subjects are imported relatively (`./dispatcher-plugin.js`, which vitest transforms from `src/`), so no `dist/` rebuild applies. Mutation and restore went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which uses a must-hit anchor and verifies blob hashes, with a `trap` restore as well.

- **Leg A**, fallback: `body: deferRequestBody(req),` changed to `body: req.body,` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `718ef188ae82` to `b872160649cf`). Red, the expected direction: the three `404` / `404` / `401` pins fail (`expected 400 to be 404`, `expected 400 to be 401`), and the three controls stay green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `718ef188ae82`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Leg B**, step: `readDispatchedBody(request.body)` changed to `request.body` (blob `88d109cebdcf` to `22f289504261`). Red, the expected direction: the three controls fail with `500` (the unresolved deferred body throws), and so do two existing fallback cases whose flow reads a body (`runs a flow through the automation slot ...`, `[#22147] hands the flow executor the guest ...`). The `404` / `401` pins stay green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `88d109cebdcf`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (local, at head `8b5e3b7f4`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run with no paths (change set from merge base `93b4acb57`), derives 64 commands. All 64 ran, each exit code captured before any pipe, and all exited 0. `--ran` verdict: "64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 64 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Among them: `check:route-envelope`, `check:slot-lookup` ("ratchet holds: 101 unswept site(s) in 25 file(s), none new"), `check-system-context-census` (OK), `check:nul-bytes` (OK), `check:test-source-alias` (OK) and `check:cross-package-test-inputs` (OK).
- Five roster families keep their roster under a directory this diff touches. They ran in addition and all exited 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity` and `check:route-ledger-census`.
- eslint: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed source files exited 0 with no output. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- On the pre-merge head `f23824394`, two commands first exited 3 (prerequisite not met). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit `621a4876`, which this shallow clone lacked; after fetching it, the re-run exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed unbuilt workspace packages; on `8b5e3b7f4` it measured that 111 require entry points across 69 packages load. The merge of `origin/main` `93b4acb57` touched only `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates*`.
- Left to CI, not run locally: the `repo` vitest project (`test:repo`; no file in this diff is in it), the workspace type-check lanes, Build Core, the Test Core shards and dogfood. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from` is not owed, because no exported symbol is renamed or removed.

Diff: 4 files, +246 / -4 (`dispatcher-plugin.ts` +9/-1, `api-endpoint-step.ts` +20/-3, new pin file +201, changeset +16).

## Acceptance notes

- `EndpointExecutionRequest.body`'s doc line in `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-executor.ts` ("The fallback seam populates it exactly as a route does") still holds for what the executor receives, which is the body the step read. The deferral is documented where it happens: in `AppEndpointExecutionInput.request` and at the step's read. `endpoint-executor.ts` is outside the claimed file surface, so it was left alone. Carrier: none.
- The host-supplied `KernelResolver` sees `context.request` before the match. No implementation in this repository reads the body; the cloud one is NOT MEASURED here. Carrier: none.
- `dispatcher-plugin.ts`'s route-handler mount (`body: req.body` near `:305`) reads the body after its own `route.auth` decision, so it is in the right order and not this defect.
